pages.title: Cookie Policy
intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Kyvrra may use cookies and similar technologies when customers visit https://kyvrra.us.
pages.description: This Cookie Policy explains how Kyvrra may use cookies and similar technologies when customers visit https://kyvrra.us.
lines: This Cookie Policy explains how Kyvrra may use cookies and similar technologies when customers visit https://kyvrra.us.
Cookies are small files that websites may store on visitors' devices.
They can support shopping carts, checkout sessions, preferences, and other website functions.
Disabling these technologies may affect essential website functions.
Functional cookies may remember preferences such as language, display settings, or other selected options.
If enabled, analytics technologies may help us understand website traffic, visitor interactions, page performance, and technical issues.
If enabled, advertising technologies may support campaign measurement, attribution, or personalized advertising.
Such technologies may involve third-party providers.
First-party cookies are associated with Kyvrra's website.
Third-party cookies may be associated with independent services integrated into the website.
Session cookies generally expire when a browsing session ends.
Persistent cookies may remain for a defined period to support preferences or other functionality.
Our website may use local storage, session storage, pixels, tags, or other identifiers.
Their use depends on the website's active integrations.
Where a cookie preference tool is available, visitors may be able to accept, reject, or adjust optional cookies.
Browser settings may also allow cookies to be restricted or deleted.
Where legally required, nonessential technologies must be activated only after obtaining valid consent.
Visitors must be able to withdraw consent where required.
Where applicable law requires recognition of qualifying Global Privacy Control signals, those signals must be processed appropriately.
Cookie expiration periods depend on the technology and provider.
The live website's cookie inventory should identify the actual cookies and applicable retention periods.
Independent providers may process information under their own privacy policies.
We may update this policy when website technologies or applicable requirements change.

pages.title: Accessibility Statement
intro: At Kyvrra, we believe online shopping should be accessible and convenient for customers with different abilities and needs.
pages.description: At Kyvrra, we believe online shopping should be accessible and convenient for customers with different abilities and needs.
lines: At Kyvrra, we believe online shopping should be accessible and convenient for customers with different abilities and needs.
We aim to make our website easier to navigate, understand, and use.
Our accessibility objectives include improving the experience for customers using assistive technologies, keyboards, and mobile devices.
We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA as a reference goal for website accessibility.
This statement does not represent a verified claim that every page currently conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA.
We aim to support keyboard navigation for essential website functions, including shopping carts, forms, and checkout.
We aim to improve compatibility with commonly used screen readers and assistive technologies.
Our accessibility objectives include readable typography, appropriate text contrast, clear headings, and understandable content.
We aim to provide meaningful alternative text for informative images.
Decorative images may be marked appropriately.
We recognize the importance of accessible forms and payment processes.
Our goals include clearly labeled fields, understandable errors, and logical keyboard navigation.
We aim to provide responsive layouts and usable controls on mobile phones and tablets.
Some website functionality may depend on third-party integrations.
Accessibility limitations in those services may be outside our direct control.
If you encounter difficulty accessing our website, please contact us.
Include the page URL, a description of the problem, and any relevant browser or assistive technology details you wish to share.
Where a website accessibility issue prevents an essential shopping task, our support team can review available alternatives.
We welcome feedback and aim to review opportunities to improve website accessibility.
Support Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
